reviews.purpose: Own reviews feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the reputation context.
reviews.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

integration.purpose: Provide reusable integration assets shared by multiple reputation slices.
integration.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one slice and cross-slice reuse is explicit.
integration.justification: integration centralizes reusable context-local composition that should not duplicate across slices.
integration.createdFor: Multi-slice workflows that need shared runtime helpers.
integration.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into slice-local modules.
